title: The Ballad of Bubba - A Gameboy Color Zelda-Like
author: MelodramaticShape
selftext:
Created this game for a sibling gift exchange for Christmas. Actually going to burn it onto a few flash carts with custom labels. It's a Zelda-like based on the trials and tribulations of my dog against the eldritch horrors that are cats. Game features 5 dungeons, 6 bosses, a handful of mini games and a small overworld. 

For development, I used a [GB Studio ](https://github.com/eoinjordan/gb-studio-agent)MCP. Here's my general agent stack and tools used. If you are creating pixel art with Fable, you want to do at most 3 16x16 tiles at a time per sub-agent run. If you try to more than that, it's going to look like shit IMO.

If you have a semi decent GPU, transcribe existing audio into MIDI, split that to stems and then have an agent arrange that stem for the gameboy synth. If you generate music
